subject: Verizon Small Cell Applications
overview: The Medford Ad Hoc Small Cell Committee met to continue public hearings on Verizon applications for small cell wireless installations across the city. The committee approved 14 applications with standard and site-specific conditions, while denying applications for 101 Sheridan Avenue, 204 Winthrop Street, and 45 Brogan Road.

items.title: Hearing Opening and Policy Overview
items.summary: Tim McGivern called the continued hearing to order, and Robin Stein summarized the 12 standard conditions required for all small cell applications.

items.title: 101 Sheridan Avenue (Application 29)
items.summary: Denied the application for 101 Sheridan Avenue after Verizon declined to withdraw without prejudice, citing neighborhood petitions, visual impact, and available alternative pole locations.

items.title: 281 Boston Avenue (Application 14)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions and confirmation that the existing double pole will be removed.

items.title: 204 Winthrop Street (Application 17)
items.summary: Denied the application for failing to satisfy ADA sidewalk clearance requirements under section 4B of the city policy.

items.title: 24 Tesla Avenue (Application 50)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 42 Martin Street (Application 53)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 90 North Street (Application 52)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 104 College Avenue (Application 10)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions following review of resident emails concerning health, safety, and proximity to a school.

items.title: 21 Fairmont Street (Application 13)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 32 Brookings Street (Application 18)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions after addressing public comments regarding proximity to Barry Park and network coverage.

items.title: 42 Quincy Street (Application 51)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 25 Brooks Park (Application 2)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions and a requirement to consult the traffic director if relocating a pole street sign becomes necessary.

items.title: 13 Bradley Road (Application 22)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 87 4th Street (Application 23)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions.

items.title: 10 Cherry Street (Application 28)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to standard conditions, with additional requirements that a remnant partial pole be fully removed and the traffic director be consulted regarding street sign placement.

items.title: 148 Washington Street (Application 32)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to the 12 standard conditions after taking testimony from a Kurukula Center representative regarding cybersecurity concerns.

items.title: 4 Central Avenue (Application 33)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to standard conditions and traffic director consultation for sign relocation.

items.title: 72 Salem Street (Application 21)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to standard conditions and traffic director consultation for sign relocation.

items.title: 117 Court Street (Application 26)
items.summary: Approved the application subject to standard conditions, with requirements to upgrade the slow children sign to current standards and consult the traffic director.

items.title: 45 Brogan Road (Application 27)
items.summary: Denied the application due to non-compliance with the 36-inch ADA sidewalk clearance requirement.

items.title: 71 Central Avenue (Application 31)
items.summary: Taken up out of order and approved subject to standard conditions and traffic director sign relocation approval.
